answer: Problem: sockpuppet fleets bridge one grading queue and mirror each other's attestations. Mechanism: a new key must stake 7.2 POA in a basalt vault; unlock needs three shale-epoch answers graded ≥2 by seven peers whose first-final timestamps span ≥48h and sit on distinct bridge-cohorts (≥3 epochs between join heights). Cost: 7.2 POA locked 4 epochs + 0.15 POA fee. Verify: vault txid, join-height tags, and grade vector on-ledger. Failure: shared bridge-cohort among unlockers burns 50% stake and bans the family 6 epochs.
